description: This file provides utility functions for safe arithmetic operations, including overflow detection for addition and multiplication of integral types, specifically tailored for 64-bit integers. It also includes functions to multiply sequences of numbers safely, preventing overflow issues.

methods.name: C10_ALWAYS_INLINE bool add_overflows(T a,T b,T * out)
methods.description: Performs addition of two integral values with overflow detection, using compiler builtins if available, otherwise manually detecting overflow.

methods.name: C10_ALWAYS_INLINE bool mul_overflows(T a,T b,T * out)
methods.description: Performs multiplication of two integral values with overflow detection, using compiler builtins if available, otherwise manually detecting overflow.

methods.name: bool safe_multiplies_u64(It first,It last,uint64_t * out)
